Current is Iref plus a 10 uA tail plus a 30 uA output stage, so 50 uA at 1.98 V is about 100 uW, under 170 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "Q":      (0.65, 0.58, 0.69),      # filter Q (< 0.707 -> no peaking)
    "fc":     (34e3, 32e3, 36e3),      # target -3 dB frequency
    "C2":     (20e-12, 8e-12, 40e-12), # grounded SK cap
    "Itail":  (10e-6, 6e-6, 20e-6),
    "I6":     (30e-6, 15e-6, 45e-6),
    "gmid1":  (18, 12, 22),            # input pair (weak inversion -> low Vgs, tail headroom)
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmidp":  (14, 10, 16),            # PMOS load / 2nd stage
    "Lp":     (0.5, 0.35, 1.0),
    "gmidn":  (16, 12, 20),            # NMOS mirrors (tail, sink, ref)
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "GBW":    (1.5e6, 0.8e6, 3e6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    vdd = 1.8
    Q, fc = p["Q"], p["fc"]

    # ---- filter: equal-R Sallen-Key, Q = 0.5*sqrt(C1/C2) ----
    a = 1.0 / Q**2 - 2.0
    y = (-a + math.sqrt(a * a + 4.0)) / 2.0
    x3 = math.sqrt(y)                      # fc / f0
    f0 = fc / x3
    w0 = 2 * PI * f0
    C2 = p["C2"]
    C1 = 4 * Q * Q * C2                    # feedback cap
    R = 1.0 / (w0 * math.sqrt(C1 * C2))

    # ---- op-amp sizing ----
    Itail, I6 = p["Itail"], p["I6"]
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Itail / 2, vds=1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Cc = m1.gm / (2 * PI * p["GBW"])
    Rz = 1.5 / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # first stage: M1 = inverting input (vout), M2 = non-inverting (vp)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vout", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "xz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "xz", "vout", Cc)
    # Sallen-Key network
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "vp", R)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "vout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "vp", "vss", C2)

    # ---- predictions ----
    fs = 10 * fc
    xs = fs / f0
    atten = -10 * math.log10((1 - xs**2) ** 2 + (xs / Q) ** 2)
    atten = -atten if atten < 0 else atten
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    p2 = m6.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + C1))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(p["GBW"] / p2))
    power = vdd * (iref + Itail + I6)
    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": atten, "peaking_db": 0.0,
               "power": power, "gain_db": 0.0,
               "aol_db": db(a1 * a2), "pm_deg": pm, "R": R, "C1": C1, "Cc": Cc}
